key_facts: 18-year-old African male with no prior medical history
Presented with 2-day history of tonsillitis
Developed abdominal cramping and diarrhea 3 days later
Fever and joint pains in wrists, elbows, and knees

Biliterally coarse crepitations on lung exam
Audible S3 gallop on cardiovascular exam
Abdomen distended and tense with hypoactive bowel sounds
WBC 27.1×10^9/L, Hb 10.9 g/dL, platelets 281×10^9/L
Procalcitonin 71.6 ng/mL, CRP 287 mg/L
Creatinine 494 μmol/L, urea 26.7 mmol/L
Liver tests showed AST 1461 U/L and ALT 812 U/L
Urine albumin:creatinine ratio was 52.3 mg/mmol
Cardiac markers were elevated (troponin 17 137 ng/mL; CK > 7800 U/L)
Chest X-ray showed pulmonary edema and cardiomegaly
Echocardiogram revealed dilated cardiomyopathy with EF 30–35%
Abdominal CT demonstrated distended bowel with splenic and renal infarcts
